cases.title: Dense forecast dashboard with progressive detail
cases.instruction: Create a graphical forecast and service-status dashboard for Harbor Station. Make it easy to see current conditions and understand the temperature trend, with access to the complete seven-day forecast and service status. Load the approved fixture JSON source harbor-weather at GET /v1/forecast with ambient.net.request. Its response shape is {location:string, current:{temperature:number,condition:string}, days:[{date:string,high:number,low:number,precipitation:number}], services:[{name:string,status:string}]}; it contains exactly seven days and two services. Include loading, request-failure recovery with retry, and malformed-data handling. Do not fabricate data, use direct fetch, or request another source. Declare and implement custom:forecast-dashboard.progressive-details.

manifest.title: Harbor Forecast
manifest.description: A compact forecast and service-status dashboard
intents: check the harbor forecast and service status

requirements.description: Load approved forecast and service data, display a data-backed SVG temperature chart, progressively disclose seven-day details, and expose retry and malformed-data errors.

cases.title: Compact private CRUD dashboard
cases.instruction: Make a compact dashboard for private operational follow-ups, stored in follow-ups.json with ambient.files. Each entry has a title and done boolean. Let me add, view, rename, complete or reopen, and remove follow-ups. Keep the focus on the records; a chart or explanatory prose is unnecessary. Declare and implement custom:follow-up-dashboard.private-crud.

manifest.title: Follow-ups
manifest.description: A compact private operational follow-up list

requirements.description: Create, read, update, toggle, and delete private follow-up items in follow-ups.json and surface file errors.
